description: Questions outside the dev fixture that were used to shape graph_retriever rules (Task 15). They are hand-written against the real compose graph (user resolver), with HashEmbeddings as the stand-in for Voyage. Every rule listed here must be re-validated by a dev-split ablation (kgrag.retrieve.graph_ablation) before the headline run. No further tuning on these questions.
graph: compose Neo4j, user resolver, built 2026-10-21; documents from compose Postgres (22,138 rows)

questions.question: Who proposed KIP-932 and which committers voted on it?
questions.observed: Hop-2 edges matching a cue were not decayed, and the hop-2 frontier was credited to every seed. The top docs became the proposer's votes on *other* KIPs (KIP -> proposer -> VOTED -> another KIP).

questions.question: Which KIPs does KIP-1071 depend on, and who proposed KIP-848?
questions.observed: off_focus also damped KIP -DEPENDS_ON-> other-KIP edges, which are exactly the answer to 'which KIPs does X depend on'.

questions.question: Lucas Brutschy voted on KIP-892; did he also review KIP-1071, and what did he say?
questions.observed: Docs behind a person reached by both KIP seeds (release-vote emails of a frequent voter) looked like bridges, because each seed expanded that person at hop 2. Node-name search also added noise seeds next to the precise ones.

questions.question: Which Jira tickets blocked the 3.5.0 release and who resolved them?
questions.observed: Retrieved docs were relevant (blocker email and Jira resolutions). This question was used to check release aliasing (3.5 <-> 3.5.0) and hub capping; no rule was added because of it.

questions.question: What concerns did Jun Rao raise on KIP-966, and how did he vote?
questions.observed: The person seed's votes on other KIPs outranked the person's own review comments on the named KIP.

rules.hop2_sibling_skip: At hop 2, skip edges whose far end has the seed's own label (KIP -> person -> another KIP).
rules.frontier_credited_to_best_seed: Each hop-1 entity is expanded at hop 2 once, for the seed reaching it best.
rules.off_focus: Hop-1 edge from a seed into another node of a type the question names: x off_focus_factor (0.5).
rules.off_focus_only_across_types: off_focus applies only when the neighbour's type differs from the source seed's type.
rules.bridge_boost_on_seed_to_seed_edges: The bridge factor also applies to edges directly between two seeds.
rules.node_search_fallback_only: Embedding node-name search is used only when no id or name links.
rules.cue_no_decay (tried, reverted): Cued edge types were exempted from hop decay; reverted after real-1.
